gloss: kabedon (pinning someone to a wall with one hand)

definitions.gloss: kabedon; pinning someone against a wall with one hand
definitions.explanation: Slamming one hand against a wall so that the other person is cornered, a romantic gesture familiar from manga and TV dramas.

examples.english: Someone pinned me against the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{壁|かべ}ドン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Kabedon scenes often appear in shojo manga.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{壁|かべ}ドン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流行語|りゅうこうご}→流行語：13307_ryuukougo⟧になった。
examples.english: A popular actor did a kabedon in a TV drama, and the word became a buzzword that year.

notes:
From ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (wall) + ドン (thud). Before the romance sense spread around 2014, the word meant banging on the wall of an apartment to complain about a noisy neighbor, and it can still mean that.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁|かべ}ドン⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {壁|かべ}ドン⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to do / receive a kabedon
- {壁|かべ}ドン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧: a kabedon scene
